decision.name: ACCEPT_READER_LOCK_INTEGRATION_RETAIN_ORPHAN_FAIL_CLOSED_GATE
decision.integration_result: Public load_observations now acquires the same ArchiveWriterLock as append_observations; append uses _load_observations_unlocked inside its existing lock, avoiding recursive deadlock. runner.run_once calls public load_observations so the previously identified in-flight partial JSONL read exposure is addressed for cooperating readers. No confirmed production incident.
decision.remaining_blocker: Crash-orphan .jsonl.lock now blocks BOTH writes and public reads (including offline run_once) until lock acquisition timeout; no automatic recovery and no documented safe operator recovery protocol. Single-file anata_latest.json is atomically replaced; pinned three-file generation mismatch remains diagnostic because known production consumer reads only one handoff.
decision.test_contract: At exact SHA in tmp_path, seed one valid row; spawn writer holding ArchiveWriterLock after flushing half of second JSON body; require PARTIAL event before starting reader. Reader must signal ATTEMPT immediately before public load_observations; assert no result before RELEASE (catch queue.Empty specifically), release writer in finally, bounded joins and exitcode==0, assert two unique complete records and no .lock. Add positive control for complete JSON body without newline. Separate crash child os._exit(17) inside lock; assert subsequent load_observations and append_observations raise bounded TimeoutError; only remove orphan lock after verifying no live owner, then assert recovery; do not auto-delete unknown live locks. Do not confuse per-file atomic visibility with three-file generation consistency.
decision.new_test_quality_caveat: Current test lacks an explicit reader ATTEMPT handshake and uses broad pytest.raises(Exception) for Queue.get timeout, so it can pass a pre-reader scheduling delay. This is an acceptance gap, not evidence the production reader lock failed.
decision.reason_no_queue: Gemini structured JSON reliability remains UNVERIFIED; no repeat malformed or duplicate tasks. Fresh B/C exact-SHA reviews pending.

execution_blocker.next_feasible_recovery: Supervisor provide authorized isolated exact-SHA checkout or independent test runner for targeted and full pytest; C validate reader ATTEMPT oracle, A document orphan-lock safe manual recovery; B/C reassess new public SHA.
